prompts.1f124d2a44ad:
Look at this document image and answer each question:

1. COLUMNS: If there is a transaction table with rows of dates,
   descriptions, and amounts, list the exact column headers
   separated by " | ".
   If there is no transaction table, write NONE.

2. PAID: Is there evidence that payment was completed?
   Look for: payment method, "PAID" stamp, amount tendered,
   change given, receipt number, EFTPOS/card details.
   Answer YES or NO.

3. ROWS: How many line items or transaction rows are visible?
   Answer with a number.

4. TRAVEL: Is this a flight ticket, e-ticket, boarding pass, or
   travel itinerary (showing passenger names, flights, or travel
   legs)? Answer YES or NO.
prompts.4faf339e27dd:
Read this scanned receipt and report four fields.

Write each field on its own line, in this order and this format:

company: <registered business name, e.g. ACME TRADING SDN BHD>
date: <date printed on the receipt>
address: <full street address of the business>
total: <final total amount paid, e.g. 4.95>

Give the registered company name, not a brand or outlet name.
Do not include the company registration number printed in brackets.
Write the date exactly as the receipt prints it.
Write the total with its decimal point and no currency symbol, e.g. 4.95.
Write NOT_FOUND as the value of any field the receipt does not show.
prompts.6a0a108860f8:
Extract ALL data from this invoice image. Respond in exact format below with actual values or NOT_FOUND.

DOCUMENT_TYPE: INVOICE
BUSINESS_ABN: NOT_FOUND
SUPPLIER_NAME: NOT_FOUND
BUSINESS_ADDRESS: NOT_FOUND
PAYER_NAME: NOT_FOUND
PAYER_ADDRESS: NOT_FOUND
INVOICE_DATE: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_QUANTITIES: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_PRICES: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_TOTAL_PRICES: NOT_FOUND
IS_GST_INCLUDED: NOT_FOUND
GST_AMOUNT: NOT_FOUND
TOTAL_AMOUNT: NOT_FOUND

Instructions:
- Find ABN: 11 digits like "12 345 678 901"
- Find supplier: Business name at top
- Find customer: "Bill To" section
- Find date: Use DD/MM/YYYY format
- Find line items: List with " | " separator
- Find amounts: Include $ symbol
- Find IS_GST_INCLUDED: Does TOTAL_AMOUNT include GST? Answer true if GST
  is part of the total, whether it is added to a subtotal ("Subtotal",
  "GST (10%)", "Total") or stated as included in the prices ("GST
  INCLUDED", "Incl. GST"). Answer false only if the document says no GST
  was charged. Answer NOT_FOUND if GST is not mentioned. Use lower case:
  true or false
- Replace NOT_FOUND with actual values
prompts.e142bc42bbb4:
Extract ALL data from this receipt image. Respond in exact format below with actual values or NOT_FOUND.

DOCUMENT_TYPE: RECEIPT
BUSINESS_ABN: NOT_FOUND
SUPPLIER_NAME: NOT_FOUND
BUSINESS_ADDRESS: NOT_FOUND
PAYER_NAME: NOT_FOUND
PAYER_ADDRESS: NOT_FOUND
INVOICE_DATE: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_QUANTITIES: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_PRICES: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_TOTAL_PRICES: NOT_FOUND
IS_GST_INCLUDED: NOT_FOUND
GST_AMOUNT: NOT_FOUND
TOTAL_AMOUNT: NOT_FOUND

Instructions:
- Find ABN: 11 digits like "12 345 678 901"
- Find store: Business name at top
- Find transaction date: Use DD/MM/YYYY format
- Find purchased items: List with " | " separator
- Find item names: The product name on its own, with no leading count. A
  line printed as "3x <item name>" gives the item name by itself, and the
  count goes in LINE_ITEM_QUANTITIES
- Find quantities: One plain number per item, digits only, like "3" rather
  than "3x". Write 1 for an item the receipt shows no count for, so the
  quantity list is the same length as the item name list
- Find line totals: The amount printed against an item is the total for
  that whole line and goes in LINE_ITEM_TOTAL_PRICES. It already covers
  every unit, so never multiply it by the quantity
- Find unit prices: Decide per line from that line's quantity. Quantity 1
  means the single printed amount is also the unit price, so write it.
  Quantity 2 or more means the per-unit figure is not printed anywhere,
  so write NOT_FOUND for that line. Never divide a line total to produce
  a unit price. Keep one entry per item so the list stays the same length
  as the item name list
- Find amounts: Include $ symbol
- Find IS_GST_INCLUDED: Does TOTAL_AMOUNT include GST? Answer true if GST
  is part of the total, whether it is added to a subtotal ("Subtotal",
  "GST (10%)", "Total") or stated as included in the prices ("GST
  INCLUDED", "Incl. GST"). Answer false only if the document says no GST
  was charged. Answer NOT_FOUND if GST is not mentioned. Use lower case:
  true or false
- Replace NOT_FOUND with actual values
prompts.f84c760a2320:
Extract ONLY DEBIT/WITHDRAWAL transactions (money OUT) from this bank statement for expense tracking.
SKIP all deposits, credits, salary payments, and money IN transactions entirely.

Respond in this exact format with actual values or NOT_FOUND:

DOCUMENT_TYPE: BANK_STATEMENT
STATEMENT_DATE_RANGE: NOT_FOUND
TRANSACTION_DATES: NOT_FOUND
LINE_ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS: NOT_FOUND
TRANSACTION_AMOUNTS_PAID: NOT_FOUND

STOP after TRANSACTION_AMOUNTS_PAID. No explanations or additional text.

Instructions:
- STATEMENT_DATE_RANGE: Find the statement period, written as "DD/MM/YYYY - DD/MM/YYYY"
- TRANSACTION_DATES: Dates of DEBIT transactions only, separated by " | "
- LINE_ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS: Descriptions of DEBIT transactions only, separated by " | "
- TRANSACTION_AMOUNTS_PAID: DEBIT/withdrawal amounts with $ separated by " | "

HOW TO IDENTIFY DEBITS (money OUT):
- Amounts with negative sign (-$50.00) or in a Debit column
- Keywords: withdrawal, payment, purchase, fee, charge, ATM, EFTPOS, direct debit
DO NOT INCLUDE (money IN):
- Keywords: deposit, credit, salary, wages, transfer in, interest received, "Direct Credit"

CRITICAL RULES:
1. Extract ONLY debit/withdrawal transactions - completely SKIP credits and deposits
2. Keep items in the same order across all fields (date 1 matches description 1 matches amount 1)
3. Use " | " as separator between items
4. Include $ symbol for amounts
5. Replace NOT_FOUND with actual values
